headline: Fortnite Battle Royale
title: Fortnite Facts | Free Mode Built in Two Months | Classic Games
video_script: Fortnite began as a paid early access game called Save the World in July twenty seventeen. After Battlegrounds took off, Epic Games built Battle Royale on top of it in about two months and released it free on September twenty sixth, twenty seventeen. It reached ten million players in two weeks. Did you play from season one? Comment below!
description: Fortnite Battle Royale launched free September 26, 2017. Sources: Wikipedia, Shacknews.
joke: Everyone lands on Tilted Towers and nobody knows why.
